description: Source code for input event processing on Android within the Starboard platform, including key and pointer event translation, joystick handling, and DPad/hat input synthesis.

classes.name: InputEventsGenerator
classes.description: Class responsible for generating input events from Android game activity events, including key, pointer, joystick, and DPad handling.

methods.name: CreateInputEventsFromGameActivityEvent
methods.description: Main entry point to create input events from a game activity event, dispatching to specific handlers based on event type.

methods.name: ProcessPointerEvent
methods.description: Processes pointer (touch/mouse) input events and generates corresponding Starboard input events.

methods.name: ProcessJoyStickEvent
methods.description: Processes joystick motion events, including axes for thumbsticks, and generates move events.

methods.name: CreateInputEventsFromSbKey
methods.description: Creates press and unpress key events for a given SbKey.

methods.name: ProcessFallbackDPadEvent
methods.description: Handles special processing for fallback DPad keys to differentiate between hat and thumbstick inputs.

methods.name: UpdateHatValuesAndPossiblySynthesizeKeyEvents
methods.description: Updates hat (DPad) axis values and synthesizes key events if values change significantly.

methods.name: UpdateDeviceFlatMapIfNecessary
methods.description: Updates the mapping of device axes flatness for joystick input processing.
